entry.title: hiring a junior researcher for OPEN BAR

link.title: hiring a junior researcher for OPEN BAR

entry.content:
The ALL lab is officially launching! 🚀

We are recruiting a junior researcher (“incarico di ricerca” research position) to work on the OPEN BAR project (see the OPEN BAR project page for more details). The purpose of the position is to address the replicability issues for studies reporting an advantage in attentional control efficiency for people who speak two or more languages compared to those who speak only one. Specifically, the researcher will contribute to the development of a web app to facilitate the direct replication of bilingual-advantage studies and will carry out direct replication for a sample of them.

The position is for 3 years with a gross annual salary of €22,500.00. Applicants must hold a Master’s degree in Psychology, Linguistics, or related disciplines and be competent in cognitive psychology, cognitive neuroscience, and/or psychometrics. The ideal candidate has some experience in systematic literature reviews, including the extraction and structured annotation of data, materials, and/or code from scientific publications; basic knowledge of sample planning, designing and conducting behavioral experiments, and data analysis; familiarity with the principles and practices of open science, particularly pre-registration and transparent management of data, materials, and/or code; and strong communication skills in English.

For more information, please see the official call (in Italian) here, and an unofficial AI-generated English translation here.

Applications may be submitted from this page. Instructions for registering on the submission platform and completing the application can be found in English here and in Italian here.

The deadline for applications is December 23, 2026.
